tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Find Caliper UI components, blocks and Pro screens by what they do (for example 'date range', 'billing usage', 'chat composer'). Returns names to pass to the other tools.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: A component's docs as Markdown: when to use it, install command, props for every part, keyboard and accessibility notes. Includes the usage example for Free parts, and for Pro parts when the caller has a licence.

tools.name: get_component_source
tools.description: Every source file the component needs, with the path to write it to. Pro parts need Authorization: Bearer <CALIPER_TOKEN> on the MCP connection and an active Pro or Team licence.

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: The components.json registry config and the shadcn CLI command that installs the given parts with their dependencies.

tools.name: get_design_rules
tools.description: The conventions to follow when building UI with Caliper UI in this project: tokens, hierarchy, focus, motion and interface copy.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_component_source" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
